name: PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Steel Pipe Industry of Indonesia Tbk, together with its subsidiary, PT Spindo Engineering Industry, manufactures and sells steel pipes/tubes and other related products in Indonesia and internationally. It operates through Steel Pipe Mill; Spiral Steel Pipe Mill; Strips and Plate; and Services and Others segments.
